Seal of Wartorn Fate is a currency used for Bonus Rolls in Battle for Azeroth dungeons, raids and world bosses, similar to the use of Elder Charm of Good Fortune or Warforged Seal in previous expansions. Only two may be bought weekly, but more may be acquired by other means up to a maximum of 5 seals.

SearchWarcraft.com [http://www.searchwarcraft.com/] is one of many Google-based World of Warcraft search engines. The site only includes known WoW resource sites in its results, allowing users to remove qualifier words normally needed when searching for WoW-specific content in Google. [http://www.searchwarcraft.com/help] The site allows for users to submit new sites for inclusion in the search results and welcomes community involvement to ensure quality results. [http://www.searchwarcraft.com/help/suggest] Lastly, there are SearchWarcraft.com browser plugins that allow for easy searches to be launched from Firefox 2.0 or Internet Explorer 7.0. The heart of a black dragon could bestow fiery enchantments upon weapons, and they wanted those enchantments. One pandaren brewmaster shared a separate view from most of the pandaren who had been hired by the Alliance in order to fight the blood elves. These pandaren mercenaries tried to keep blood elves from getting to Outland. However one lone pandaren did not share the opinion of his brethren and chose to join Prince Kael'thas and Lady Vashj when they broke out of the dungeons and went through a portal to Outland to escape the Alliance. This pandaren assisted the heroes in rescuing Illidan from enemy forces.

The Seat of the Naaru is the central section of the Exodar where O'ros, a naaru, resides down on the lower levels. It is a circular area with purple flux shimmering in the center. The area contains entrances to the bank, Alliance-linked Auction House, and hallways leading to three other wings. Both the Auction House and bank have mailboxes by their entrances. The area also has small trading posts of General Goods and Bags. During the Battle for the Exodar, the seat was invaded by the Burning Legion, with High General Rakeesh, Velen's son, killing O'ros, the last prime naaru. With its death, the seat remains empty.

The Secret Lab is a small lab located within a crater like hole in southern Azshara. It houses a few experiments that the Bilgewater goblins have been performing, most notably on raptors. They, like the goblins at Area 52, have built a working rocket to space. X. Nizzlebex is the director of the Secret Lab, but something appears to have gone terribly wrong. All the buildings are on fire, and the buzzer to request assistance indicates no one is home. Research Interns can be found running around attempting to extinguish themselves. Meanwhile, Subject Four, apparently an escaped experiment, seeks to exact revenge on humanoids, while Subject Nine attempts to formulate an escape plan.

Sebastian Hayward is one of the Hayward brothers that are being attacked by Forsaken Castaways at the Hayward Fishery. The brothers are planning on evacuating by water, but the Cataclysm damaged their boats and they are in need of repair before they can leave. The Forsaken boats were also damaged, and the survivors have appeared at the Fishery to attack the five brothers. It's unknown what happens to the brothers after the evacuation.

Arena Season 9 (Vicious) commenced on 14 December 2010, one week after the release of Cataclysm and ended on June 28, 2011, coinsiding with the release of patch 4.2.0. The season lasted 28 weeks. Season 9 is notable for being the first season with rated battlegrounds. It also introduced some new features such as War Games, which are player managed unrated arena battles.

The Seat of the Chosen is a Twilight's Hammer ogre mound within the Darkwhisper Gorge of Mount Hyjal. There appears to be a major friction between the ogres and non-ogre members of the cult. High Cultist Azennios is meeting with the leader of the ogres, Karr'gonn, to ease the conflict. Gromm'ko has a pet raptor named Butcher that has killed three of Instructor Devoran's core hound pups. Devoran wants payback.

Sector 17 is a sector within Gnomeregan. The entire sector belongs to High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque as his private quarters, where he prefers to have a practical abode, rather than a fancy one like most of the other Alliance leaders. The network of hallways in sector 17 was a physical representation of Gelbin's creative process: library connected to drafting room connected to simple foundry connected to assembly chamber. Research, imagination, creation, engineering. This was where numbers had been rallied, partnered with iron, and sent marching forward. If one did not know better, they'd believe the place to be some crazy old geezer's library.

Seaspittle Nook is a tiny cave at the northern end of Krasarang Cove in the southeastern reaches of Krasarang Wilds. After the Alliance and Horde build their bases this small cave is dug out by the Explorers' League and becomes part of the Ruins of Ogudei.

The Seat of Knowledge is the home of the Lorewalkers faction, including Lorewalker Cho. It can be found above the entrance to Mogu'shan Palace in the northeast corner of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Not surprisingly, Brann Bronzebeard found his way here and decided to set up shop as an archaeology trainer, while he shares information with the Lorewalkers. The right side of the Seat of Knowledge is set up with various tables and display stands. Archaeologist adventurers may, on rare occasion, uncover a pristine specimen of a Pandaren, Mogu or Mantid artifact that is an ideal donation for permanent display here.
